description: Golden corpus compatibility anchor for TerraFusion OS autonomy toolchain

contracts.determinismDescription: Determinism is defined as structural determinism: canonical manifest ordering, stable file count, and consistent content. Byte-perfect ZIP hashes are NOT guaranteed due to manifest.generatedAt timestamps.

errorCodeSemantics.description: When a file is missing, the verifier returns HASH_MISMATCH (empty hash vs expected) rather than FILE_MISSING. This is intentional: the hash check subsumes presence check.

additiveFieldsPolicy.condition: New fields may be added to schemas in minor versions. Existing fields MUST NOT be removed or have their semantics changed without a major version bump.

notes: This lockfile is auto-generated during RC release. Manual edits require governance approval.
